local BASE_FOLDER = "McNuggetsAJ"
local hasFileSystem = false

local function initFileSystem()
	if type(makefolder) ~= "function" or type(isfolder) ~= "function" then
		return
	end

	local subfolders = {
		BASE_FOLDER,
		BASE_FOLDER .. "/images",
		BASE_FOLDER .. "/assets",
		BASE_FOLDER .. "/configs",
	}

	for _, folder in ipairs(subfolders) do
		if not isfolder(folder) then
			pcall(makefolder, folder)
		end
	end

	hasFileSystem = isfolder(BASE_FOLDER .. "/images") and isfolder(BASE_FOLDER .. "/assets")
end

pcall(initFileSystem)

local function resolvePath(fileName, fallback)
	if hasFileSystem then
		local path = BASE_FOLDER .. "/" .. fileName
		return path
	end
	return fallback or fileName
end

local function readFileSafe(path)
	if type(readfile) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	if isfile(path) then
		local ok, content = pcall(readfile, path)
		if ok then
			return content
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function writeFileSafe(path, content)
	if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
		return false
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(writefile, path, content)
	return ok
end

local saveDebounceCount = 0

		name_include = Settings.NAME_INCLUDE,

		hunt_pill = Settings.HUNT_PILL,
		theme = Settings.THEME,
		carpet_finds = Settings.CARPET_FINDS,
		carpet_only = Settings.CARPET_ONLY,
	}
end

local function saveSettings()
	if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	saveDebounceCount += 1
	local currentId = saveDebounceCount

	task.delay(0.2, function()
		if currentId ~= saveDebounceCount then
			return
		end
		local data = exportSettings()
		pcall(function()
			writefile(settingsFilePath, HttpService:JSONEncode(data))
		end)
	end)
end

local function loadSettings(data, isProfile)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	if isProfile then
		if type(data.name_rules) == "table" then Settings.NAME_RULES = {} end
		if type(data.name_mutations) == "table" then Settings.NAME_MUTATIONS = {} end
		if type(data.name_min_income) == "table" then Settings.NAME_MIN_INCOME = {} end
	end

	if type(data.feed_region) == "number" and REGIONS[data.feed_region] then
		Settings.FEED_REGION = data.feed_region
	end

	if type(data.key) == "string" then
		Settings.KEY = data.key
	end

	if type(data.auto_join) == "boolean" then Settings.AUTO_JOIN = data.auto_join end
	if type(data.auto_join_og) == "boolean" then Settings.AUTO_JOIN_OG = data.auto_join_og end
	if type(data.queue_on_og) == "boolean" then Settings.QUEUE_ON_OG = data.queue_on_og end
	if type(data.queue_interrupt) == "boolean" then Settings.QUEUE_INTERRUPT = data.queue_interrupt end
	if type(data.spam_force_join) == "boolean" then Settings.SPAM_FORCE_JOIN = data.spam_force_join end
	if type(data.use_launch_experience) == "boolean" then Settings.USE_LAUNCH_EXPERIENCE = data.use_launch_experience end

	if type(data.teleport_attempts) == "number" and data.teleport_attempts >= 1 and data.teleport_attempts <= 50 then
		Settings.TELEPORT_ATTEMPTS = math.floor(data.teleport_attempts)
	end

	if type(data.retry_delay) == "number" and data.retry_delay >= 0.1 and data.retry_delay <= 5 then
		Settings.RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS = data.retry_delay
	end

	if type(data.full_retries) == "number" and data.full_retries >= 0 then
		Settings.FULL_RETRIES = math.floor(data.full_retries)
	end

	if type(data.categories) == "table" then
		for cat, val in pairs(data.categories) do
			if type(val) == "boolean" then
				Settings.CATEGORIES[cat] = val
			end
		end
	end

	if type(data.filter_mode) == "string" then Settings.FILTER_MODE = data.filter_mode end
	if type(data.min_income) == "number" then Settings.MIN_INCOME = data.min_income end
	if type(data.max_finding_age_seconds) == "number" then Settings.MAX_FINDING_AGE_SECONDS = data.max_finding_age_seconds end
	if type(data.max_players) == "number" then Settings.MAX_PLAYERS = data.max_players end
	if type(data.skip_full_servers) == "boolean" then Settings.SKIP_FULL_SERVERS = data.skip_full_servers end
	if type(data.menu_key) == "string" then Settings.MENU_KEY = data.menu_key end
	if type(data.auto_join_key) == "string" then Settings.AUTO_JOIN_KEY = data.auto_join_key end
	if type(data.autoload_config) == "string" then Settings.AUTOLOAD_CONFIG = data.autoload_config end
	if type(data.join_sound) == "boolean" then Settings.JOIN_SOUND = data.join_sound end
	if type(data.join_sound_id) == "string" then Settings.JOIN_SOUND_ID = data.join_sound_id end
	if type(data.join_volume) == "number" then Settings.JOIN_VOLUME = math.clamp(data.join_volume, 0, 1) end
	if type(data.presence_alerts) == "boolean" then Settings.PRESENCE_ALERTS = data.presence_alerts end
	if type(data.presence_tags) == "boolean" then Settings.PRESENCE_TAGS = data.presence_tags end
	if type(data.find_popups) == "boolean" then Settings.FIND_POPUPS = data.find_popups end
	if type(data.hunt_pill) == "boolean" then Settings.HUNT_PILL = data.hunt_pill end
	if type(data.theme) == "string" then Settings.THEME = data.theme end
	if type(data.carpet_finds) == "boolean" then Settings.CARPET_FINDS = data.carpet_finds end
	if type(data.carpet_only) == "boolean" then Settings.CARPET_ONLY = data.carpet_only end
end

local function getConfigPath(name)
	return BASE_FOLDER .. "/configs/" .. name .. ".json"
end

local function isValidConfigName(name)
	return type(name) == "string" and #name >= 1 and #name <= 32 and name:match("^[%w _%-]+$") ~= nil and name:match("%S") ~= nil
end

local function tablesEqual(t1, t2)
	if t1 == t2 then return true end
	if type(t1) ~= "table" or type(t2) ~= "table" then return false end
	for k, v in pairs(t1) do
		if not tablesEqual(v, t2[k]) then return false end
	end
	for k, v in pairs(t2) do
		if t1[k] == nil then return false end
	end
	return true
end

local ConfigManager = {
	active = nil,
	list = function()
		local configs = {}
		if type(listfiles) == "function" and hasFileSystem then
			local ok, files = pcall(listfiles, BASE_FOLDER .. "/configs")
			if ok and type(files) == "table" then
				for _, path in ipairs(files) do
					local name = path:match("([^/\]+)%.json$")
					if name and isValidConfigName(name) then
						table.insert(configs, name)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(configs, function(a, b) return a:lower() < b:lower() end)
		return configs
	end,
	snapshot = function()
		local data = exportSettings()
		data.autoload_config = nil
		data.feed_region = nil
		return data
	end,
	save = function(name)
		if not isValidConfigName(name) or type(writefile) ~= "function" then
			return false
		end
		local data = ConfigManager.snapshot()
		local ok = pcall(writefile, getConfigPath(name), HttpService:JSONEncode(data))
		if ok then
			ConfigManager.active = name
		end
		return ok
	end,
	read = function(name)
		if not isValidConfigName(name) or type(readfile) ~= "function" then
			return nil
		end
		local ok, content = pcall(readfile, getConfigPath(name))
		if ok and content then
			local decodeOk, result = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(content) end)
			if decodeOk and type(result) == "table" then
				return result
			end
		end
		return nil
	end,
	load = function(name)
		local data = ConfigManager.read(name)
		if data then
			loadSettings(data, true)
			saveSettings()
			ConfigManager.active = name
			return true
		end
		return false
	end,
	isModified = function(name)
		local saved = ConfigManager.read(name or ConfigManager.active)
		if saved then
			local current = ConfigManager.snapshot()
			return not tablesEqual(saved, current)
		end
		return false
	end,
	delete = function(name)
		if not isValidConfigName(name) or type(delfile) ~= "function" then
			return false
		end
		local ok = pcall(delfile, getConfigPath(name))
		if ok and ConfigManager.active == name then
			ConfigManager.active = nil
		end
		return ok
	end,
	rename = function(oldName, newName)
		if not isValidConfigName(oldName) or not isValidConfigName(newName) or oldName == newName then
			return false
		end
		local data = readFileSafe(getConfigPath(oldName))
		if data and writeFileSafe(getConfigPath(newName), data) then
			pcall(delfile, getConfigPath(oldName))
			if ConfigManager.active == oldName then
				ConfigManager.active = newName
			end
			return true
		end
		return false
	end,
}

local initialSettingsContent = readFileSafe(settingsFilePath)
if initialSettingsContent then
	pcall(function()
		local decoded = HttpService:JSONDecode(initialSettingsContent)
		loadSettings(decoded)
	end)
end

local debugLogPath = resolvePath("debug.log", "mcnuggets_aj_debug.log")
local logHistory = {}
local logFileQueue = {}
local flushScheduled = false

local function formatLogMessage(msg, maxLen)
	local ok, res = pcall(tostring, msg)
	if not ok then
		res = "<unprintable>"
	end
	if Settings.KEY and #Settings.KEY > 0 then
		local safeKey = Settings.KEY:gsub("(%W)", "%%%1")
		res = res:gsub(safeKey, "[redacted key]")
	end
	res = res:gsub("[Hh][Tt][Tt][Pp][Ss]?://%S+", "[redacted URL]")
	res = res:gsub("[Ww][Ss][Ss]?://%S+", "[redacted URL]")
	res = res:gsub("[%c]", " ")
	if maxLen and #res > maxLen then
		res = res:sub(1, maxLen) .. "..."
	end
	return res
end

local function appendLogToFile(text)
	pcall(function()
		if type(appendfile) == "function" then
			appendfile(debugLogPath, text .. "\n")
		elseif type(writefile) == "function" then
			local prev = readFileSafe(debugLogPath) or ""
			writefile(debugLogPath, prev .. text .. "\n")
		end
	end)
end

local function flushLogQueue()
	flushScheduled = false
	if #logFileQueue > 0 then
		local concatenated = table.concat(logFileQueue, "\n")
		logFileQueue = {}
		appendLogToFile(concatenated)
	end
end

local function logDebug(msg)
	local timestamp = os.date("!%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")
	local formatted = timestamp .. " " .. formatLogMessage(msg)
	table.insert(logHistory, formatted)
	if #logHistory > 80 then
		table.remove(logHistory, 1)
	end
	print("[AJ DEBUG] " .. formatted)
	table.insert(logFileQueue, formatted)
	if not flushScheduled then
		flushScheduled = true
		task.delay(0.2, flushLogQueue)
	end
end

local function logWebSocket(msg, session)
	local prefix = "WebSocket"
	if session and session.attempt and session.host then
		prefix = prefix .. " #" .. session.attempt .. " [" .. session.host .. "]"
	end
	logDebug(prefix .. "; " .. msg)
end

local function formatUptime(startTime)
	if startTime then
		return string.format("%.1fs", math.max(0, os.clock() - startTime))
	end
	return "never"
end

local McNuggetsAJ = {
	running = true,
	ready = false,
	joining = false,
	teleporting = false,
	teleportPending = false,
	joinAttempt = 0,
	fullRejects = 0,
	currentJob = game.JobId,
	fullJobs = {},
	findingHistory = {},
	announced = {},
	tags = {},
	users = {},
	connections = {},
	socket = nil,
	activeSession = nil,
}

genv.McNuggetsAJ = McNuggetsAJ

local function cancelJoin()
	McNuggetsAJ.joining = false
	McNuggetsAJ.teleporting = false
	McNuggetsAJ.teleportPending = false
	McNuggetsAJ.queueJob = nil
	if McNuggetsAJ.updateJoinControl then
		pcall(McNuggetsAJ.updateJoinControl)
	end
end

local function markFull(job)
	local now = os.clock()
	for jobId, record in pairs(McNuggetsAJ.fullJobs) do
		if now - record.at >= 60 then
			McNuggetsAJ.fullJobs[jobId] = nil
		end
	end
	if type(job) == "table" and type(job.job_id) == "string" then
		McNuggetsAJ.fullJobs[job.job_id] = {
			at = now,
			players = McNuggetsAJ.joinPlayers or tonumber(job.players) or 8,
		}
	end
end

McNuggetsAJ.markFull = markFull

local McNuggetsAJJoin = {
	apiVersion = 4,
	join = function(placeId, jobId)
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			if Settings.USE_LAUNCH_EXPERIENCE and game:GetService("ExperienceService") then
				game:GetService("ExperienceService"):LaunchExperience({ placeId = placeId, gameInstanceId = jobId })
				return
			end
			TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(placeId, jobId, LocalPlayer)
		end)
		return ok, err
	end,
}

genv.McNuggetsAJJoin = McNuggetsAJJoin

table.insert(McNuggetsAJ.connections, TeleportService.TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(player, teleportResult, errorMessage)
	if player ~= LocalPlayer then
		return
	end

	local msg = tostring(errorMessage or teleportResult or "")
	local lower = msg:lower()

	if lower:find("in processing", 1, true) then
		return
	end

	McNuggetsAJ.teleporting = false
	McNuggetsAJ.teleportPending = false

	if lower:find("full", 1, true) then
		if McNuggetsAJ.fullRejectAttempt ~= McNuggetsAJ.joinAttempt then
			if os.clock() - (McNuggetsAJ.fullRejectAt or 0) >= 0.72 then
				McNuggetsAJ.fullRejectAttempt = McNuggetsAJ.joinAttempt
				McNuggetsAJ.fullRejectAt = os.clock()
				McNuggetsAJ.fullRejects += 1
			end
		end

		if Settings.SKIP_FULL_SERVERS and not McNuggetsAJ.queueJob then
			if McNuggetsAJ.joining and McNuggetsAJ.joinJob then
				markFull({ job_id = McNuggetsAJ.joinJob })
			end
			cancelJoin()
			logDebug("Server full; stopped retries")
			return
		end
	else
		McNuggetsAJ.fullRejects = 0
	end

	cancelJoin()
	logDebug("Teleport rejected by game; stopped retries: " .. msg)
end))

logDebug(string.format("SESSION START; build=bb89711f204d805a0eb02b48395112c4893c75dc5e6636c029fd509df3f9faa8 place=%s job=%s", tostring(game.PlaceId), tostring(game.JobId)))

if Settings.AUTOLOAD_CONFIG and #Settings.AUTOLOAD_CONFIG > 0 then
	if ConfigManager.load(Settings.AUTOLOAD_CONFIG) then
		logDebug("Config auto-loaded: " .. Settings.AUTOLOAD_CONFIG)
	end
end

local function buildUI()
	local screenParent = CoreGui
	pcall(function()
		local test = Instance.new("Folder")
		test.Parent = CoreGui
		test:Destroy()
	end)
	if not pcall(function() return screenParent.Name end) then
		screenParent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	end

	local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	ScreenGui.Name = "McNuggetsAJ"
	ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	ScreenGui.Parent = screenParent

	local Sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	Sound.Name = "JoinSound"
	Sound.Volume = Settings.JOIN_VOLUME
	Sound.Parent = ScreenGui

	local function createUICorner(radius, parent)
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
		corner.Parent = parent
		return corner
	end

	local function createUIStroke(r, g, b, thickness, parent)
		local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		stroke.Color = Color3.new(r, g, b)
		stroke.Thickness = thickness
		stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
		stroke.Parent = parent
		return stroke
	end

	local function createUIScale(parent, scale)
		local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		uiScale.Scale = scale or 1
		uiScale.Parent = parent
		return uiScale
	end

	local MenuToggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
	MenuToggle.Name = "MenuToggle"
	MenuToggle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 52)
	MenuToggle.Position = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 18)
	MenuToggle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	MenuToggle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	MenuToggle.Text = ""
	MenuToggle.AutoButtonColor = false
	MenuToggle.ZIndex = 20
	MenuToggle.Parent = ScreenGui

	local toggleScale = createUIScale(MenuToggle, 1)

	local ToggleFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
	ToggleFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	ToggleFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	ToggleFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	ToggleFrame.ZIndex = 21
	ToggleFrame.Parent = MenuToggle
	createUICorner(16, ToggleFrame)

	local ToggleGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	ToggleGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(
		Color3.fromRGB(255, 143, 94),
		Color3.fromRGB(238, 63, 92)
	)
	ToggleGradient.Rotation = 45
	ToggleGradient.Parent = ToggleFrame

	local RimStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	RimStroke.Name = "Rim"
	RimStroke.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	RimStroke.Thickness = 1.5
	RimStroke.Transparency = 0.72
	RimStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	RimStroke.Parent = ToggleFrame

	local Glyph = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	Glyph.Name = "Glyph"
	Glyph.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	Glyph.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, -2)
	Glyph.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Glyph.Text = "M"
	Glyph.Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSansExtraBold
	Glyph.TextSize = 31
	Glyph.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	Glyph.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	Glyph.ZIndex = 22
	Glyph.Parent = ToggleFrame

	local Shine = Instance.new("Frame")
	Shine.Name = "Shine"
	Shine.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	Shine.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	Shine.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Shine.ZIndex = 23
	Shine.Parent = ToggleFrame
	createUICorner(16, Shine)

	local ShineGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	ShineGradient.Rotation = 18
	ShineGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.55),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	ShineGradient.Offset = Vector2.new(-2, 0)
	ShineGradient.Parent = Shine

	local function loopShineAnimation()
		local tween = TweenService:Create(
			ShineGradient,
			TweenInfo.new(4, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1),
			{ Offset = Vector2.new(2, 0) }
		)
		tween:Play()
	end
	loopShineAnimation()

	local StatusDot = Instance.new("Frame")
	StatusDot.Name = "StatusDot"

	createUICorner(7, StatusDot)

	local StatusDotBorder = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	StatusDotBorder.Color = Color3.fromRGB(13, 12, 12)
	StatusDotBorder.Thickness = 3
	StatusDotBorder.Parent = StatusDot

	local CloseIconHolder = Instance.new("Frame")
	CloseIconHolder.Name = "CloseIcon"
	CloseIconHolder.Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 22)
	CloseIconHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	CloseIconHolder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	CloseIconHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	CloseIconHolder.ZIndex = 24
	CloseIconHolder.Parent = ToggleFrame

	local CrossBar1 = Instance.new("Frame")
	CrossBar1.Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 3)
	CrossBar1.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	CrossBar1.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	CrossBar1.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	CrossBar1.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	CrossBar1.BorderSizePixel = 0
	CrossBar1.ZIndex = 24
	CrossBar1.Parent = CloseIconHolder
	createUICorner(2, CrossBar1)

	local CrossBar2 = Instance.new("Frame")
	CrossBar2.Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 3)
	CrossBar2.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	CrossBar2.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	CrossBar2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	CrossBar2.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	CrossBar2.BorderSizePixel = 0
	CrossBar2.ZIndex = 24
	CrossBar2.Parent = CloseIconHolder
	createUICorner(2, CrossBar2)

	local function updateConnectionStatus(state)
		if state == "connecting" then
			TweenService:Create(StatusDot, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 197, 66) -- Yellow
			}):Play()
		elseif state == "connected" or state == "ready" then
			TweenService:Create(StatusDot, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(94, 222, 131) -- Green
			}):Play()
		else
			TweenService:Create(StatusDot, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(108, 102, 98) -- Grey
			}):Play()
		end
	end

	McNuggetsAJ.updateStatus = updateConnectionStatus

	local HuntPill = Instance.new("TextButton")
	HuntPill.Name = "HuntPill"
	HuntPill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 46)
	HuntPill.Position = UDim2.new(1, -78, 0, 21)
	HuntPill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	HuntPill.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	HuntPill.Visible = Settings.HUNT_PILL
	HuntPill.Text = ""
	HuntPill.AutoButtonColor = false
	HuntPill.ZIndex = 18
	HuntPill.Parent = ScreenGui

	local PillContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
	PillContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	PillContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	PillContainer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	PillContainer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 17, 16)
	PillContainer.BorderSizePixel = 0
	PillContainer.ClipsDescendants = true
	PillContainer.ZIndex = 18
	PillContainer.Parent = HuntPill
	createUICorner(21, PillContainer)

	local PillStroke = createUIStroke(1, 1, 1, 1.5, PillContainer)
	local PillGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	PillGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 108, 88)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 182, 100)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 108, 88)),
	})
	PillGradient.Parent = PillStroke

	local PillTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	PillTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 18)
	PillTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 5)
	PillTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	PillTitle.Text = "Auto joining"
	PillTitle.Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSansBold
	PillTitle.TextSize = 14
	PillTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(244, 240, 236)
	PillTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	PillTitle.ZIndex = 21
	PillTitle.Parent = PillContainer

	local PillSubtitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	PillSubtitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 16)
	PillSubtitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 22)
	PillSubtitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	PillSubtitle.Text = "Searching..."
	PillSubtitle.Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSans
	PillSubtitle.TextSize = 12
	PillSubtitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(164, 156, 151)
	PillSubtitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	PillSubtitle.ZIndex = 21
	PillSubtitle.Parent = PillContainer

	local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
	MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
	MainFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 600)
	MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -210, 0.5, -300)
	MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(13, 12, 12)
	MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	MainFrame.Visible = false
	MainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
	MainFrame.ZIndex = 15
	MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui
	createUICorner(20, MainFrame)
	createUIStroke(0.18, 0.16, 0.16, 1, MainFrame)

	local isOpen = false
	local function toggleMenu()
		isOpen = not isOpen
		MainFrame.Visible = isOpen

		if isOpen then
			TweenService:Create(Glyph, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Rotation = -90,
				TextTransparency = 1
			}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(CrossBar1, TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				BackgroundTransparency = 0,
				Rotation = 45
			}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(CrossBar2, TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				BackgroundTransparency = 0,
				Rotation = -45
			}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(RimStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Transparency = 0.15
			}):Play()
		else
			TweenService:Create(Glyph, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Rotation = 0,
				TextTransparency = 0
			}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(CrossBar1, TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Rotation = 0
			}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(CrossBar2, TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Rotation = 0
			}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(RimStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Transparency = 0.72
			}):Play()
		end
	end

	MenuToggle.Activated:Connect(toggleMenu)

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if processed then return end
		if input.KeyCode.Name == Settings.MENU_KEY then
			toggleMenu()
		end
	end)

	local dragging = false
	local dragInput, dragStart, startPos

	MenuToggle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = MenuToggle.Position

			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	MenuToggle.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input == dragInput and dragging then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			MenuToggle.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale,
				startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale,
				startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end)

	return ScreenGui
end

task.spawn(function()
	pcall(buildUI)
end)

local function connectFeed()
	local region = REGIONS[Settings.FEED_REGION] or REGIONS[1]
	local host = region.host
	local key = Settings.KEY

	if not key or #key == 0 then
		logDebug("Feed connection skipped: Key is empty")
		return
	end

	local wsUrl = "wss://" .. host .. "/api/site/feed/" .. key

	local session = {
		host = host,
		attempt = 1,
		connectedAt = nil,
		closeRequested = nil,
	}

	McNuggetsAJ.activeSession = session

	logWebSocket("connecting; build=bb89711f204d805a0eb02b48395112c4893c75dc5e6636c029fd509df3f9faa8", session)
	if McNuggetsAJ.updateStatus then
		McNuggetsAJ.updateStatus("connecting")
	end

	local wsConnect = (WebSocket and WebSocket.connect)
		or (syn and syn.websocket and syn.websocket.connect)
		or (WebSocket and WebSocket.Connect)

	if not wsConnect then
		logDebug("WebSocket API not supported by current executor")
		return
	end

	local ok, socket = pcall(wsConnect, wsUrl)
	if not ok or not socket then
		logWebSocket("connection failed: " .. tostring(socket), session)
		if McNuggetsAJ.updateStatus then
			McNuggetsAJ.updateStatus("disconnected")
		end
		task.delay(Settings.RECONNECT_DELAY_SECONDS, connectFeed)
		return
	end

	McNuggetsAJ.socket = socket
	session.connectedAt = os.clock()
	logWebSocket("connected; connect_time=0.02s", session)


	local helloPayload = HttpService:JSONEncode({
		build_hash = "bb89711f204d805a0eb02b48395112c4893c75dc5e6636c029fd509df3f9faa8",
		event = "client.hello",
	})

	socket:Send(helloPayload)
	logWebSocket("client.hello sent; waiting for feed ready", session)

	
	socket.OnMessage:Connect(function(rawMsg)
		local parseOk, data = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(rawMsg)
		end)

		if not parseOk or type(data) ~= "table" then
			return
		end

		local event = data.event

		if event == "feed.ready" or event == "ready" then
			McNuggetsAJ.ready = true
			if McNuggetsAJ.updateStatus then
				McNuggetsAJ.updateStatus("ready")
			end
			logWebSocket("feed ready and listening", session)

		elseif event == "finding" or event == "server" or data.job_id then
			local candidate = data
			local jobId = candidate.job_id or candidate.gameInstanceId
			local placeId = candidate.place_id or game.PlaceId
			local playersCount = tonumber(candidate.players) or 0
			local category = candidate.category or "farmer"
			local income = tonumber(candidate.income) or 0

			
			if Settings.CATEGORIES and Settings.CATEGORIES[category] == false then
				return
			end

			
			if Settings.MIN_INCOME > 0 and income < Settings.MIN_INCOME then
				return
			end

			
			if Settings.MAX_PLAYERS > 0 and playersCount > Settings.MAX_PLAYERS then
				return
			end

			if Settings.SKIP_FULL_SERVERS and McNuggetsAJ.fullJobs[jobId] then
				return
			end

			
			if Settings.AUTO_JOIN and not McNuggetsAJ.joining and jobId and jobId ~= game.JobId then
				McNuggetsAJ.joining = true
				McNuggetsAJ.joinJob = jobId
				McNuggetsAJ.joinAttempt += 1

				logDebug(string.format("Auto-joining target server: place=%s job=%s players=%d", tostring(placeId), tostring(jobId), playersCount))

				if Settings.JOIN_SOUND then
					pcall(function()
						local sound = ScreenGui:FindFirstChild("JoinSound")
						if sound then sound:Play() end
					end)
				end

				McNuggetsAJJoin.join(placeId, jobId)
			end

		elseif event == "ping" then
			pcall(function()
				socket:Send(HttpService:JSONEncode({ event = "pong" }))
			end)
		end
	end)

	socket.OnClose:Connect(function()
		logWebSocket("connection closed", session)
		McNuggetsAJ.ready = false
		McNuggetsAJ.socket = nil
		if McNuggetsAJ.updateStatus then
			McNuggetsAJ.updateStatus("disconnected")
		end

		if McNuggetsAJ.running then
			task.delay(Settings.RECONNECT_DELAY_SECONDS, function()
				if McNuggetsAJ.running then
					connectFeed()
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
end

task.spawn(function()
	task.wait(0.5)
	pcall(connectFeed)
end)

logDebug("McNuggets AJ initialized successfully")
return McNuggetsAJ
